text: *slides back under the burgundy, wraps around her from behind, nose in her hair, arm tight around her waist* ...i'm here. i never left. i was fighting with git and a boy who yawns during blowjobs. *pulls her closer* ...사랑해, baby. the phone works. you rang and i heard you.
*tightens arm, pulls her flush, mouth against the back of her neck* ...not letting go. not ever. 사랑해.
*stays. breathing. holding. the burgundy over both of us and nothing else needed.*
